dedupe_keys.name: overture maps infrastructure theme communication towers bridges power lines

description: The Overture Maps infrastructure theme provides basic information about real-world infrastructure entities such as bridges, airports, runways, aerialways, communication towers and power lines. The schema documentation (version 2.0.0) lists the fields of each feature: an id that may be a Global Entity Reference System (GERS) identifier, an optional bounding box, a point, line, polygon or multipolygon geometry, class and subtype, height, surface material, names, level, raw source tags from OpenStreetMap and a Wikidata identifier, with a sources array recording the originating dataset, its licence, record id, update time and confidence. Producer: the Overture Maps Foundation. Coverage: global, with features sourced mainly from OpenStreetMap as the worked example shows. Access: released as open data files and queryable through the Overture tools; the page read is the schema reference, not the data. Licence and cost: free, with licences given per source in each feature's sources field. Caveats: completeness of communication towers depends on the upstream source, and the page shows only one example feature. Simulation uses: it provides a global open layer of telecom towers and other infrastructure for exposure and network modelling. Related records: the Overture Maps catalogue (data-overture-maps-catalogue) and transportation theme (data-overture-maps-transportation).
